# Oroboros Design

> Web design studio from Cologne, Germany. Fixed-price websites for local businesses: Standard website EUR 99, Premium website EUR 199. One-off payment, no subscription, by card (Stripe) or bank transfer on invoice. Owner: Daouda Ndiaye.

## Offers

- Standard website — EUR 99, one-off. One page with up to five sections, designed for phone, tablet and desktop; contact by call, WhatsApp, form and map; copy from the client's details; basics for Google and AI assistants; one round of changes; draft ready within 48 hours of payment and questionnaire.
- Premium website — EUR 199, one-off. Up to five pages; individual design with motion and scroll effects; existing booking or reservation tool connected; image editing; structured data and llms.txt; two rounds of changes; draft ready within five working days of payment and questionnaire.
- Not included: the domain itself, shop systems, photo shoots, copy in further languages. Larger projects get a written fixed-price quote.
- Add-ons (optional): website care EUR 39/month; AI chat for the website EUR 99/month; Nennbar (visibility in AI answers, free check); Bildtakt (short clips from photos, from EUR 149).

All prices are final prices. As a small business under § 19 UStG (Germany), no VAT is charged.

## How it works

1. Book: choose a package, pay by card or request an invoice (two minutes).
2. Questionnaire: services, contact, opening hours, logo, photos (ten minutes).
3. Approve: review the draft in the browser, name changes, go live. Files and access belong to the client.
